risk_note: RV2 (new feedback module + identity deletion cleanup port + migration + contract generated files). S-15 / CT-26q submitProductFeedback (D10-697 / D10-698): platform idempotency → feedback.enabled off 30145 → link_id exists in this app else 30144 → same transaction: logged-in submit takes the app.users row FOR SHARE and reads the deletion status (deletion started → written as guest, no user_id; BR-ID-28), then pg_advisory_xact_lock(app, device) and the +08:00 daily count against feedback.daily_limit_per_device (42901, nothing written) → insert. The signing device must belong to the app (10403). Deletion cleanup step deleteFeedbackForUser removes the user's rows, guest rows stay; no retention deletion (BR-ID-30, pending legal). Config keys registered by B1-28q (#2456). New migration 0125_product-feedbacks (renumbered to main max + 1 at landing). Removes x-implementation planned of submitProductFeedback; generated files regenerated. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).

reviews.note: r1 fail (S1 feedback committed after the deletion cleanup kept the user_id; S2 device from another app accepted) → rule tests attempt 3 added #32–#35 (red against r1) → implementation r2 → r2 pass, 0 findings (couli-runs/B1-28p/review-money-r1.json, review-money-r2.json); Codex unavailable (approvals #36). Follow-up: platform signature layer does not compare the device app with the token app for logged-in requests (recorded in impl-opus-2.json notes).

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by independent Claude through claude-run.sh (attempts 1–3); reviews r1 pass, r2 (after attempt 3) pass (couli-runs/B1-28p/review-spec-r1.json, review-spec-r2.json; one r2 run rejected for a worktree position change while the implementation was being edited, content pass, rerun clean); red: attempt 1–2 PASS 60 tests in 7 files, attempt 3 #32–#35 red against implementation r1 (red3.out)

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
